mutations.name: the fixer-exit sent-back gate is never waivable
kills: the sent-back gate after a fixer's exit, when the seat notice fails offers the owner's waive-proof, never recommended, after a fix-proof wake
the sent-back gate after a fixer's exit, when the seat notice fails records the waiver at that head and reviews it again when the owner waives

mutations.name: the fixer-exit sent-back gate is waivable after every wake kind
kills: the sent-back gate after a fixer's exit, when the seat notice fails offers no waive-proof after a review wake

mutations.name: a notice goes to its seat whether or not the seat holds a live session
mutations.find: if (ports.live === undefined || (await liveOrUnread(ports.live, seat))) return { seat };
kills: the seat notice sends a retired seat's exit notice to the first live fallback, and records which (TP-3958)

mutations.name: an unreadable roster reads every seat as retired
kills: the seat notice keeps the seat when the roster cannot be read, as before liveness was checked

mutations.name: the held seat notice drops the wake's findings
kills: a held send-back, whose successor agent-chat refused carries the held wake's findings to the seat, cut to the notice's cap
